description.value: Sootay Smoke and Convenience Store is a locally owned smoke, vape, and convenience shop serving Fort St. John from 93 Avenue. Beyond its extensive smoke and vape selection, it stocks snacks, drinks, phone accessories, lifestyle goods, and an on-site water refill station. The store also serves Taylor, BC, giving it a broader regional footprint than a typical neighbourhood convenience stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms this is a real, active convenience/smoke shop at 9516 93 Ave, Fort St John, BC, with matching phone and address. The products page explicitly lists '18.9L jug water refills available on-site' under a branded water refill service, confirming potable water access on premises. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, hot food, or cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Sootay Smoke and Convenience Store' but the website's primary branding is 'Sootay Smoke & Vape Shop'; the About page uses 'Sootay Smoke & Vape Shop and Convenience Store'. OSM name retained per schema rules.
Water refill service is marketed as an 18.9L bulk jug refill program (Canadian Water Serve and Save) — whether staff will fill a cyclist's water bottle on request is not explicitly stated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible convenience store with a confirmed web presence, matching address and phone, and snacks/water available — useful to passing cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Store also operates a second location in Taylor, BC, per website.

Water bottle refill.detail: Products page lists 'Canadian Water Serve and Save – Stay hydrated with affordable 18.9L jug water refills available on-site. Clean, local, and convenient.' Potable water is available on premises via this refill station
